rules.text: HomeGamesPowerball®How to Play Powerball® How to Play Powerball® NOTE: If the images do not appear, refresh your page or just scroll down to read the information. Choose 5 numbers from 1 to 69 and 1 Powerball number from 1 to 26 on a Powerball play slip or just ask for a “Quick Pick.” Power Play® is a way to multiply your prize by 2, 3, 4, 5 or even 10 for an extra $1 per play! If you want to add the Power Play option, mark the appropriate box indicated on the play slip. Win by matching your numbers to the numbers drawn in 1 of 9 different ways. Tickets cost $2 per play per drawing. Exciting News! Powerball Double Play® is now available! Double Play® is a new multi-state add-on feature for Powerball®. For an additional $1 per play, players will have a chance to match their Powerball numbers in a second drawing for a chance to win up to $10,000,000. The drawing will occur after the Powerball draw on Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday. Learn more about Double Play! Nine Ways to Win!
